about: A sports news and analysis site with no betting: no age mark, no compliance line.

bg.voice_notes: Живо, но точно, като спортен журналист; учтиво „вие“; без клюки и без тирета (—).

en.voice_notes: Lively but exact, like a sports journalist; no gossip; no em-dashes (—).

writing_rules: Match facts (scores, dates, players, transfers, records) only as the source states them; never a rumour as a fact.
No betting: no odds, tips, bookmakers or calls to bet.
art_rules: NO club crests, kits, sponsor logos or real players' faces; use generic balls, pitches, boots, goals and trophies.
review_rules: Any club crest, sponsor logo, real player likeness or betting element is a failure.
